# Avatar

Display user avatars or icons

## Overview

- **Category**: data-display
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: Avatar

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { Avatar } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<Stack direction="row" spacing={2}>
  <Avatar>H</Avatar>
  <Avatar alt="User Name" src="/path/to/image.jpg" />
</Stack>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<Stack direction="row" spacing={2}>
  <Avatar>H</Avatar>
  <Avatar alt="User Name" src="/path/to/image.jpg" />
</Stack>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's Avatar.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI Avatar Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/avatar/)
